Frequently Asked Questions How can I login? Click the 'Log in' button located at the top right corner. Fill in your email & password. Click on 'Log in' & enjoy! NOTE: Once you subscribe, your password will be sent to your email How can I watch Albunyaan on TV? You can watch Albunyaan on TV through the following methods: TV Box (Best Option): Download the Albunyaan app directly onto your TV box for the best viewing experience. This option provides full control over your TV, including parental controls and other settings. Android TV: If you have an Android TV, you can download the Albunyaan app directly from the TV store. Chromecast: You can cast Albunyaan from your phone, tablet, or computer to your TV using a Chromecast device. TV Browser: You can also watch Albunyaan through our website using the TV browser. However, please note that this method may cause bugs and issues and is the least recommended option. For detailed instructions and necessary downloads, please visit our: Downloads Page. Why is most of the content in Arabic? Many people, especially parents living in Western countries, ask this question. While we have Dutch and English content available, we have deliberately chosen to prioritize Arabic as the most prominent language. This is the language every Muslim parent should prioritize for their children. Despite some people thinking that transitioning from their native language to Arabic is too difficult, this is not the case. Experience shows that everyone, especially children, can quickly master the language. The younger the child is, the easier it is for them to learn Arabic and understand Islam as a whole. Albunyaan is a tool that can help us motivate, encourage, and raise our children. The beginning will always be difficult, but if we as parents give up when our children want something different, we are feeding their desires. In fact, there have been parents who do not speak Arabic themselves, but their children nevertheless speak and write fluent Arabic with the help of the right multimedia content they are exposed to. Why is Albunyaan not completely free? Albunyaan is a non-profit da3wah foundation. Everything we get is sadaqah, because it's being invested in the da3wah. Everyone who participates in this is doing it for Allaah's sake. If we were able to, we would make it free for everyone. Which payment methods do you provide? We provide iDeal, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, China UnionPay, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Bancontact, SEPA & Link. How can I change my account password? If you are using a web browser: Go to the menu and hover the mouse over your photo. Click on "Dashboard". Scroll down to find the button labeled "Change password". Click on the button and enter your current password and your new password. Click on "Save changes". Your password has been changed! Can I contribute to Albunyaan? Yes, definitely. You can contribute to Albunyaan in the following ways: Donate to support this project and other similar Islamic projects. Share this project with your family, relatives, friends, and anyone you know in the Muslim community. "Guiding someone to goodness is equivalent to the reward of the person who does it." as the Prophet, sallallaahu3alayhiwassalam, said. Inform us of any content that contains any violations of Islamic principles, whether in speech or action. Can I be a sponsor? Please email us at info@albunyaan.tv with the details of your sponsorship, including the amount and duration. Any other question? Contact us here Who are we?
